description: This file defines the Monitor class and related nested classes and data structures for a plugin system, including memory monitoring, JSON serialization, and restart management. It declares interfaces for plugin lifecycle, web processing, and JSON-RPC, along with internal mechanisms for monitoring memory and operational status of components.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData
classes.description: Holds memory measurement data including resident, allocated, shared, and process metrics, with methods to add, measure, reset, and access these measurements.

classes.name: Monitor::Data
classes.description: Represents a JSON serializable data structure for monitoring information, including name, measurements, observable, and restart info.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData::Measurement
classes.description: Stores min, max, average, and last measurements for a specific metric.

classes.name: Monitor::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for the Monitor plugin, including observables and restart settings.

classes.name: Monitor::Config::Entry
classes.description: Represents a configuration entry for a monitored observable, including callsign, memory limits, operational status, and restart info.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects
classes.description: Manages a collection of MonitorObject instances, handles their lifecycle, scheduling, and snapshotting for monitoring purposes.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects::MonitorObject
classes.description: Represents a monitored entity with memory and operational status, including restart management, evaluation, and activity control.

methods.name: Monitor::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, setting up monitoring based on configuration.

methods.name: Monitor::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Monitor::Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Monitor::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, potentially deserializing request data.

methods.name: Monitor::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Monitor::endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Handles setting restart limits via JSON RPC.

methods.name: Monitor::endpoint_resetstats
methods.description: Resets monitoring statistics for a given observable.

methods.name: Monitor::get_status
methods.description: Retrieves current status of monitored observables.

methods.name: Monitor::event_action
methods.description: Triggers an event action, such as notifying or logging.
